title: Preliminary agenda announced for the Open Technology Research Symposium 2026
content:
This year’s Symposium is guided by the theme “Shaping the Open Transition”. The program features speakers from Fiji, Ireland, Australia, India, Slovenia, Brazil, the Netherlands, Canada, Sweden, Nigeria, Italy, Taiwan, Germany, Spain, and the United States.

title: 8 Recommendations to Shape the Future of our Brain Commons
content:
